entities.summary: Abu Bakr Abdullah al-Qirbi is a Yemeni diplomat who was minister of foreign affairs of Yemen from 2001 to 2014. He later also held the same role in the Houthis' contested cabinet formed in 2016, in spite of his former opposition to the Houthis.
